description: Upload one App Store screenshot into a single carousel slot via the screenshot bytes (screenshot_image_base64) or a URL to fetch them from (screenshot_image_url). Call once per slide (default size APP_IPHONE_65 / 6.5″); screenshot_file_path only works when the file already exists on the replay host's filesystem.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

screenshot_file_path.description: Legacy: https URL or path on SecOps replay host

screenshot_image_base64.description: PNG/JPEG base64 or data: URI (MCP preferred)

name: upload_screenshot
